QuizDeck.title: Quiz Deck
QuizDeck.description: A collection of quiz questions for a specific subject or topic.

id.description: Unique identifier for the quiz deck.

name.description: The display name of the quiz deck.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the deck was created.

questions.description: An array of questions belonging to this deck.

QuizQuestion.title: Quiz Question
QuizQuestion.description: A single multiple-choice quiz question with its details.

SourceDetails.title: Source Details
SourceDetails.description: Optional metadata extracted from an image about the source of the question.

auth.description: The application allows anonymous access for all users.

/decks/{deckId}.description: Stores all the quiz decks for the application. Each document is a full quiz deck containing all of its questions.
